label: Street lighting (State case)
tagline: A State-level case that needs a different follow-up path.

grievance.title: Non-functional street lights on the market road
grievance.text: The street lights on the main market road have not been working for several weeks. I request that the faulty street lights be repaired, and that additional lighting be considered near the market crossing for safety.

response.text: The matter has been forwarded to the local municipal body for appropriate action. The grievance is disposed at this level.
